training.note: Rebuilt 2026-07-30 via the project's own standard walk-forward pipeline (validation.py run_sport_validation/build_production_artifact pattern), replacing v6's ad-hoc 90-day/242-call operator experiment (retired -- self-documented contaminated probable_starter_era_gap, never cleared this project's own bar). Uses the full real historical dataset: 3814 train / 1082 validation / 1391 locked-holdout games (2024-04-06 through 2026-07-29), all point-in-time-safe features (pitcher_era_gap: real rolling runs-allowed; bullpen_weakness_gap: real MLB Stats API snapshots, credibility-shrunk; park_factor: real empirical factors; weather_factor: real Open-Meteo). While building this, found and fixed a real bug in ingest.py: raw score caches for 2026-07-26..29 were captured mid-day (before that evening's games finished) and were never re-fetched afterward, so data/processed/mlb/games.jsonl -- which every live Elo/trend feature reads -- was silently missing 57 real completed games. Recovered before this final fit. Chose elo_trend_park_weather_pitcher_bullpen over the raw-best variant with bullpen_fatigue added: fatigue's own live feature provider didn't exist in learned_forward.py at all (confirmed live: every real game failed to forecast), and its marginal contribution was small. bullpen_weakness_gap's live provider was added in this same change (features/bullpen.py's team_recent_relief_lines/bullpen_profile, same real functions Measured Edge already uses live). Platt recalibration was tested and explicitly rejected: folding a validation-fit Platt scale/offset into the coefficients did not reliably improve locked-holdout calibration or hit rate across variants (consistent with within-season non-stationarity -- confirmed further by this variant's own calibration slope shifting from 0.97 to 1.65 after just 57 more real games were added, i.e. real sampling instability, not a fixed miscalibration a static recalibration could correct). Does not use probable_starter_era_gap (ESPN live probables) -- the honest point-in-time replacement (point_in_time_pitcher_era_gap) exists in code but its real archive only covers 6 days so far, too little to fit or trust yet.
